Comments:
This is a very good OET letter in many ways. Purpose is very clear, Content is appropriate and well selected, and the Genre and Style is appropriate: tone, register, and formality. Also, Organisation and Layout is logical and easy to follow. 
Conciseness and Clarity are not quite right because of this:



I think this is a language issue: you need to start with the second sentence and use a word like ‘despite’. For example, despite agreeing to immediaty stop taking oxycodone for now, Mr Fox has been advised that he may take it if there is increased soreness or if he is unable to sleep. 
Also here we need Present Perfect Continuous:

“…and he has not been taking…”

Another small errors is use of ‘therefore’ when ‘and’ would sound more natural:

These last 2 points are small and they have not been enough to award below 5 (you need 3, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5)


Grade:
C+
